name: Smart button
summary: A battery button (ESP32-C3 asleep until pressed) that tells the server a single, double or long press. Other Pocket apps hear every press through Pocket Core, so a press can switch a plug, start a timer or note something.

hw_id.label: WiFi MAC address
hw_id.help: 12 characters, printed at start-up and by the “wifi” command on the serial console.

setup_help: Hold the button for 10 seconds to wake it into its serial console, connect the USB cable and paste these three lines. It sleeps between check-ins to save the battery, so changes and commands reach it at its next check-in (or right after it wakes up for something).
ap_help: A new device opens its own WiFi network by itself. One that is already set up opens it with “Open setup mode” on its page here, or by itself after a few refused WiFi logins.

settings.label: WiFi network
settings.help: The name of the WiFi network the device joins.

settings.label: WiFi password
settings.help: Empty for an open network, otherwise 8 to 64 characters. Never shown again once saved.

settings.label: Name on the network
settings.help: The name the device gives your router (DHCP host name).

settings.label: A single press means
settings.help: A name for it, shown in the history and sent with the press ("Kitchen light").

settings.label: Second press within
settings.help: How quickly the second press of a double press must follow.

settings.label: A long press is at least
Blink when pressed
settings.help: Green when the server got the press, red when it could not reach it.

settings.label: Talks to this server
settings.help: Switched on at the device itself (cfg set remote on). The server never changes it.

settings.label: Server address
settings.help: Typed into the device. The server never changes it.

settings.label: Device token
settings.help: Typed into the device. The server never changes it.

settings.label: Check in when nothing happens
settings.help: Seconds between two check-ins without a press, so you know the button is fine.

commands.name: identify
commands.label: Find it
commands.help: The light blinks for 10 seconds, so you know which one it is.

commands.name: reboot
commands.label: Restart
commands.help: The device restarts after its next check-in.

commands.name: setup_mode
commands.label: Open setup mode
commands.help: The device restarts into its own WiFi network for the setup page. It stops checking in here until it is back on your WiFi.

commands.name: cfg_reset
commands.label: Erase all settings
commands.help: The device forgets everything, including the WiFi login and this server. You will have to set it up again at the device.

alerts.label: Battery low
alerts.text: {name}: battery at {value} {unit}. Time for new batteries.

warnings.wifi: If the device cannot log in to the new network it opens its own setup network after a few refused logins.
